fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-01-07 around 13:45 hrs, it was reported that the complainant noticed that Rs. 3,50,000 had been withdrawn through multiple online transactions in a short interval. The complainant, Babu Rajan, provided the contact number 9000000365. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100055. A further person, Lokesh Karuppasamy, a driver, using the number 9000000097, is stated to be associated with the incident. The complainant could not identify the person involved. The complainant mentioned transaction records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reported unauthorised debits after sharing details during a call.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, associate, shopping complex, afternoon, receiving account, transaction record
